problem: Finding F3: B14 records a commit hash the freeze commit cannot contain; two readings of which hash commit holds.

questions.text: Which hash does the frozen header's commit record?
questions.why: The versioning rules say 'the commit it was frozen at'; the schema requires a hash; a commit cannot contain its own hash.

options.value: A: the HEAD hash at the moment of freezing (the code state the spec describes); the freeze commit that adds the file comes after it
B: the freeze commit's own hash, written by a second commit that amends the header
C: the spec file is committed with commit absent, then a second commit fills it from the first

questions.text: What does git show --stat of the freeze commit show?

options.value: the spec file plus the run folder's register, bundles and ledger
